dimensionLabels.B: 浪漫理想型 · 梦幻浪漫
dimensionLabels.C: 秩序克制派 · 理性内省
dimensionLabels.D: 自我觉醒系 · 独立强势

A: Letter To My 13 Year Old Self
D: Let You Break My Heart Again

Carousel.blurb: 循环往复的怀旧浪漫家，一生都在和回忆温柔相拥。
Carousel.lyricEn: Carousel spinning around, nowhere to go.

Forget-Me-Not.blurb: 深情执念者，认定的人与回忆，永远不会遗忘。
Forget-Me-Not.lyricEn: I've sacrificed you, all of you, completely.

Too Little, Too Late.blurb: 被错过困住的温柔灵魂，总在遗憾里自我拉扯。
Too Little, Too Late.lyricEn: 'Cause it's too little, way too late.

Castle in Hollywood.blurb: 守护青春纯粹，惋惜美好时光逐渐褪色。
Castle in Hollywood.lyricEn: We're just kids in our castle in Hollywood.

Letter To My 13 Year Old Self.blurb: 和年少自我和解，温柔拥抱所有敏感。

Dreamer.blurb: 永远活在浪漫幻想里，用想象力治愈现实。
Dreamer.lyricEn: I'm a dreamer, I'll dream my life away.

Lover Girl.blurb: 为爱勇敢奔赴，浪漫是刻在骨子里的本能。
Lover Girl.lyricEn: I'm a lover girl, I fall in love too easily.

Valentine (Jazz Version).blurb: 自带复古氛围感，温柔细腻的浪漫诗人。

From the Start.blurb: 永远带着赤诚初心，从一开始就相信美好。
From the Start.lyricEn: Don't you notice how I get quiet when there's no one else around?

Clockwork.blurb: 人生如钟表，偏爱秩序、规律与稳定。
Clockwork.lyricEn: Like clockwork, I fall apart every night.

Falling Behind.blurb: 不追赶世俗节奏，专注自己的人生步调。
Falling Behind.lyricEn: Everyone's moving faster than me, I'm falling behind.

Silver Lining.blurb: 低谷里永远寻找希望，理性自我治愈。
Silver Lining.lyricEn: There's a silver lining somewhere in this storm.

Bored.blurb: 享受无聊与独处，在松弛里获得内心平静。
Bored.lyricEn: I'm bored, oh I'm bored—nothing hits like before.

Promise.blurb: 极度重诺守信，理性坚守每一个约定。
Promise.lyricEn: You made me a promise, now you're breaking it.

Mr. Eclectic.blurb: 小众独特、不被世俗定义，活成自己的样子。
Mr. Eclectic.lyricEn: They call me Mr. Eclectic—I don't fit in one box.

Goddess.blurb: 自我价值完全由自己定义，自信耀眼、独立强大。
Goddess.lyricEn: I'm a goddess on stage, human when we're alone.

Tough Luck.blurb: 越挫越勇，从不向命运妥协。
Tough Luck.lyricEn: Tough luck, baby—I bend but I don't break.

Snow White.blurb: 拒绝世俗审美绑架，坚持自我、清醒独立。
Snow White.lyricEn: Mirrors tell lies to me, my mind just plays along.

Sabotage.blurb: 敢于打破内耗与枷锁，主动掌控人生。
Sabotage.lyricEn: I get in my head so easily—I'm my worst enemy.

Let You Break My Heart Again.blurb: 受过伤害，依然敢爱敢恨，忠于本心。
Let You Break My Heart Again.lyricEn: I'll let you break my heart again.
